## What changed and why

Describe the problem, the resulting behavior, and any compatibility impact.

## Issue / specification

Link the issue or local ticket and the relevant OpenSpec change, if applicable.
Architecture, new capability, and breaking changes require an approved proposal.

## Validation

List commands actually run, their results, and checks not run. Link RED/GREEN evidence for behavior changes.

- [ ] Relevant tests, lint, format, type checks, and docstring checks passed.
- [ ] Changed critical paths retain at least 80% line coverage per file.
- [ ] Public interfaces and user-facing documentation match the change.
- [ ] No secrets, local data, or generated test output are included.

## Review notes

Mention remaining risks, migrations, and screenshots for visible UI changes.
See [contribution guidance](https://github.com/Jackela/Impetus-Lock/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md) and the [project constitution](https://github.com/Jackela/Impetus-Lock/blob/main/CLAUDE.md).
